Chapter 6846: Who Is Xian Shen?

Chapter 6846: Who Is Xian Shen?

“As your legacy, it will only herald a calamity that you can’t handle.” Li Qiye said.

“I see.” The bear said emotionally and glanced up at the sky: “Master said that it should be fine to use an inborn legacy item. Is this not true, Young Noble?”

“Have you seen it?” Li Qiye asked.

“No, there is a veil shrouding it.” He said.

“Xian Shen is hiding your senses so you can’t find the exact location.” Li Qiye said.

“Who is Xian Shen?” Thunder Emperor couldn’t help but interject.

“The immortal who passed away here?” Bear Immortal said with uncertainty.

“We’ll see if he is truly dead. He is the second oldest of Stygian.” Li Qiye said.

“Only behind Golden Immortal.” Thunder said: “I know nothing about this immortal.”

“Because he died earlier. Otherwise, you might be speaking his title instead of Golden Immortal.” Li Qiye said: “The phenomena you both have been seeing are his illusions.”

“I have tried for a long time and couldn’t pinpoint the treasure’s location.” Bear Immortal said.

“His illusions won’t disperse long after his death. This is also due to the legacy, they’re growing stronger too.” Li Qiye said.

“Why is he lingering on?” Bear Immortal asked.

His inborn primordial immortal master died as well and was engulfed in the scent of death. This didn’t seem to be the case.

“It’s interesting since I didn’t notice it back then. Hid very well on top of improving dramatically.” Li Qiye said.

“I’m sure you saw a forest back then. I was trapped there too for a bit, unable to get out.” The bear said.

“Right, only a strong dao heart can find its way out.” Li Qiye said.

“Now it’s this whole horizon?” He looked down at the water and could remain sane, unlike Thunder Emperor.

“An unbelievable transformation.” Li Qiye said.

“How do we surpass it?” The bear asked.

“I was in a hurry and didn’t have time to ponder this through.” Li Qiye said.

“Will you try now?” The bear asked.

“I suppose I can’t let it exist since I’m already here.” Li Qiye said and utilized his supreme will.

The bear shuddered upon feeling his new power.

In this world, there was only the shallow water and nothing else. There was no end in sight, regardless of the direction. Of course, Li Qiye still didn’t miss anything.

He added more pressure and shattered the all-encompassing illusions.

“There it is!” Bear Immortal perceived the existence hidden beneath the water.

“Splash!” Li Qiye’s will lifted all the water upward, condensing it into a massive aquatic planet.

Despite its relatively fair size, its weight was unbearable for major worlds. It churned violently, attempting to escape from his will.

“Rumble!” The sheer weight and momentum could shatter immortals.

“Stop.” Li Qiye’s eyes gleamed coldly as he added more pressure.

“Boom!” The sudden freeze caused the surging sphere to explode.
